bio: Daniel Mercereau 'du bourg de Moise en Xaintonge' married Suzanne Marie Doucinet 'de la ville de la Rochelle' on 6 Aug 1693 (signers incl. 'marque X de Elisabet Dubois', Josué Mercereau, Elie Masse, Pierre Masse). Godfather of Daniel Masse (1689); his wife was godmother of Pierre (1693) and Jeanne Masse (1696). Suzanne's La Rochelle origin is the likely source of the false 'La Rochelle' claim for the Lamoureux.
sources: Registers of the French Church of New York, Collections of the Huguenot Society of America vol. 1 (1886): https://archive.org/details/collectionsofhug01hugu pp.29-31
